title: Welcome your baby
tagline: Covered, budgeted and organised before the sleepless nights start.
trigger: Baby purchases, child benefit or a stated 'we're expecting'.

steps.title: Your new monthly budget
steps.description: KBC shows what childcare, nappies and child benefit do to your monthly budget.
steps.why: Based on your own spending, nothing leaves KBC.
steps.result: Expect about €{baby_monthly} a month extra for childcare and supplies; child benefit covers about €178 of it.

steps.title: Family liability insurance
steps.description: Children are covered by family insurance from birth.
steps.why: One KBC policy for the whole family.
steps.result: Family insurance active: your baby is covered from birth.

steps.title: Add your baby to the hospital cover
steps.description: Added from birth, without a waiting period or medical questions.
steps.result: Baby added to the hospitalisation insurance from birth, no waiting period.

steps.title: Health records in one place
steps.description: Vaccinations and paediatrician reports in one app, shared only with whom you choose.
steps.why: Connected to the eHealth platform; it only needs your household.

win.customer: Never search for the vaccination card again

steps.result: Helena account ready: vaccination record and paediatrician reports in one place.

steps.title: Start saving for your child
steps.description: A savings account in your child's name with a small monthly amount. Grandparents can join.
steps.why: Opened in the app in one minute.

win.customer: About €5,400 by age 18 at €25 a month

steps.result: Savings account opened in your baby's name: €25 a month from the 10th.

steps.title: Help at home
steps.description: Service vouchers for cleaning and ironing, ordered and paid from your account.
steps.result: Service vouchers ordered: 10 a month, paid automatically.
